examples.title: enableHapticFeedback12+
examples.description:
enableHapticFeedback(enable: boolean)
Sets whether to enable haptic feedback.
To enable haptic feedback, you must declare the following permission under requestPermissions in module in src/main/module.json5 of the project.

examples.title: enableHapticFeedback18+
examples.description:
enableHapticFeedback(enable: Optional<boolean>)
Sets whether to enable haptic feedback. Compared with enableHapticFeedback12+, this API supports the undefined type for the enable parameter.
To enable haptic feedback, you must declare the following permission under requestPermissions in module in src/main/module.json5 of the project.

examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the text style in a time picker using disappearTextStyle, textStyle, and selectedTextStyle.

examples.title: Example 2: Switching Between 12-Hour and 24-Hour Formats
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to switch between 12-hour and 24-hour formats using useMilitaryTime.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Time Format
examples.description: This example shows how to set the time format using format and dateTimeOptions.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting Loop Scrolling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set whether to enable loop scrolling using loop.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Start Time
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the start time for the time picker.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the End Time
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the end time for the time picker.

examples.title: Example 7: Enabling the AM/PM Indicator to Automatically Switch Based on the Hour Value in 12-hour Format
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to enable the AM/PM indicator to automatically switch based on the hour value in 12-hour format using enableCascade and loop.
The enableCascade API is added since API version 18.
